stem:
Vihaan adds dilute hydrochloric acid to marble chips. A gas forms. He bubbles the gas through clear lime water. Lime water is calcium hydroxide in water. The lime water turns milky.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Carbon dioxide reacted with calcium hydroxide to form insoluble calcium carbonate.
The milky lime water is evidence that a chemical change has formed a new white solid.
The new white solid is calcium hydroxide.
Bubbling the same gas into plain water also turns the water milky.

teacher.key_rationale: CO2 from acid on marble turns lime water milky by forming insoluble calcium carbonate — a chemical change. The white solid is not calcium hydroxide; plain water does not turn milky with the same gas.
